Keep the existing application shell, Korean typography, family selector, mechanism selector, two equally sized Normal Cell and Vulnerable Cell diagrams, one synchronized conceptual waveform area, playback and phase controls, three concise cause/state/result explanations, and mitigation comparison control. Replace the active mechanism, diagrams, waveforms, phase labels, and educational explanation with the case below. Maintain the reference's visual hierarchy, proportions, spacing and blue-white identity. Use normal-width, readable Korean and English technical labels. Draw the circuit and waveform at the same highlighted instant. Label the plot '개념 파형' without invented device specifications. Produce one full screen with the same aspect ratio as the reference.

Active case: SRAM — 열화 불량 · Aging.
Show matched SRAM cells, one fresh and one stressed, emphasizing a transistor affected by threshold shift and reduced drive. Use a conceptual accumulated-stress timeline, not elapsed nanosecond playback. Fresh read develops by the deadline; aged read develops too slowly or has less stability margin. Plot decreasing margin versus accumulated stress with normal/aged comparison and a clear operational limit. Phases: 초기 상태 / 스트레스 누적 / 구동력 감소 / 동작 여유 소진. Mitigation 'Aging Guardband 적용'. Describe BTI/HCI as examples without guaranteeing every device ages in one direction.

Input images:
- normal-fault-comparison.png: the user's selected Option 2 design reference.

cases.title: 소프트 에러 · Soft Error / SEU
cases.brief: Compare two SRAM latches initially Q=1, QB=0. A transient particle-induced current pulse perturbs the vulnerable storage node; if enough charge is collected the latch flips and stays wrong after the pulse is gone. The normal case recovers without flipping. Show a transient injected-current pulse and paired Q response with the same event marker. Phases: 정상 보존 / 입자 충돌 / 전하 수집 / 비트 반전. Mitigation 'ECC·Scrub 적용' shows corrected readout and subsequent rewrite while acknowledging the physical upset still occurred. SER is a rate, while SEU is the illustrated event.
